schema:
CREATE TABLE players (player_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, full_name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE matches (winner_id INTEGER, loser_id INTEGER, minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, year INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (winner_id) REFERENCES players (player_id), FOREIGN KEY (loser_id) REFERENCES players (player_id));
correct_query: SELECT avg_min AS metric___, year FROM (SELECT year, AVG(minutes) AS avg_min FROM matches GROUP BY year) ORDER BY metric___, year NULLS LAST
